# freelance-rates

Standard rate card, reviewed roughly once a year rather than per-client.

- Fixed-price project work: quoted per project, not hourly
- Hourly fallback rate: used only when scope is genuinely too fuzzy to fix a price upfront
- Rush surcharge: applies when a client wants a turnaround inside the normal lead time

New clients get the standard rate with no discount; repeat clients occasionally get a modest
discount on the second project as a thank-you, not as a standing policy.

See [[acme-contact]] for the client this rate card most recently applied to.
